name: weekly-codeql-security-sweep
description: Weekly CodeQL security scan on full codebase — catches new taint sinks and security regressions.
prompt: Run CodeQL security-and-quality analysis on TypeScript/JavaScript and Java code. Check for new path traversal sinks, SQL injection patterns, XSS vectors, SSRF vulnerabilities, and hardcoded credentials. Generate weekly security scan summary. Escalate any CRITICAL findings immediately.
